label: Intellectual property, standards, and data-rights estate
domain: patents, assignments, trademarks, licenses, standards, technical baselines, government data rights, and interface control
scope: Patents, patent assignments, trademarks, licenses, standards participation, technical data and software rights, government-purpose and unlimited-rights clauses, interface control documents, reference architectures, interoperability obligations, and substitution rights. The estate separates invention, ownership, license, standard, contract clause, implementation, and control.

asset_refs.role: bounded frontier survey and acquisition preparation

boundary: A patent, assignment, standard contribution, license, contract clause, and practical control of an interface are different facts. Citation or standards participation does not establish ownership or adoption.

next_acquisition.operation: join inventions, assignments, licenses, standards, contract clauses, interface baselines, and substitution rights
next_acquisition.decisive_output: asset- and instrument-level ledger of inventors, assignees, assignments, licenses, standards role, government rights, interface control, implementation, and expiration or abandonment
